title: Clarifying Team Accounts and Roles for a team

question.author: member_283
question.body: Before I explain team accounts and roles to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: Members have full access to team folders according to their permissions. Guests are external people with limited access to specific folders only. Every role is tied to a named user account; shared accounts are not supported. Business and Enterprise plans include team accounts with three roles. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
